notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility update
notes.content:
While we are waiting for Steam's own verification process, here's what you need to know about running Mørkredd on your Steam Deck.

This game plays great on Steam Deck, and all features works as intended. You may experience some frame-drops and performance issues, but you can easily change graphics quality within the game's settings to improve that. We plan on setting a suitable default quality setting in the future.

notes.title: Minor update to remove the Aspyr launcher window
notes.content: Now the game will launch automatically without going to the Aspyr launcher window first.

notes.title: Mørkredd Wins Spillprisen 2020 GOTY Award
notes.content:
[h1]The orb is a winner! [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39109290/ede1a7b9a5f58b11ae0108899758d5da89af0ab6.png[/img]

Mørkredd was nominated for 6 categories in the Norwegian Spillprisen Awards, including Best Art, Best Tech, Fun for Everyone, Best Game Design, and Best Audio. Most exciting, Mørkredd won the prestigious Game of the Year award. 

Judges described Mørkredd  as an exciting and beautiful puzzle game in a class of its own.

To see the full list of categories, nominees, and winners, visit the [url=https://www.kavalkaden.no/]Kavalkaden[/url] website.

notes.title: The Orb Calls for a Trade
notes.content:
[h1]Introducing Mørkredd Trading Cards[/h1]

[h2]Collect cards[/h2]
Earn cards as your protect the Orb, then trade with other users through Steam and the Steam Community Market to complete your collection. 
    
[h2]Craft badges [/h2]
Craft a full set of the cards into a Mørkredd badge for your profile and display your allegiance to the orb.
   
[h2]Get rewards[/h2]
The orb isn't the only thing you can customize. Use Steam points or earn Mørkredd profile backgrounds and emoticons as you craft badges.

Prove your allegiance to the orb and collect them all!
